reviews.text: I recently had my entire roof replaced by Roof Experts and I can honestly say they exceeded my expectations. They assisted along the way as I maneuvered through the insurance process and kept me in communication the entire time. The process was seamless and the workmanship of the roof is awesome. Highly recommend!
reviews.author: Dan Hitchcock

reviews.text: Excellent company and absolutely amazing communication!!!! Pasha David was absolutely fantastic through the entire process from start to finish. I couldn't have hoped for a better experience with a roofing company. A huge Thank You to Pasha David for making the process so painless and smooth!!! The only company I'll use in the future for any of my roofing needs. Thank You!!! Thank You!!! Thank You!!!
reviews.author: M

reviews.text:
GREAT job from Nick Kincaid and Charles who always being patient on answering questions and assisting us thru the end of our roof project. They were always having an open line to make this roofing project possible even on their busy days.

I will put a " ONE STAR " on this review mainly because they've promised me that I can receive a REFERRAL BONUS after giving them another customer and it was a big project for them too. I've been waiting since August for that check and up to this point I'm  still waiting. Nick made a lot of follow ups to this matter and I even ask for Charle's help.

"NO STAR REVIEW" for the Department who is in-charge of this REFERRAL BONUS matter, you don't deserve to work with the great people in your company because you are just pulling them down.
reviews.author: Cris Valencia

reviews.text: First of all I’d like to thank Posha David. We was excellent when work with my mother. He kept her inform about everything and if something slowed it down he would sincerely apologize for it even through it was not his fault. The work he and his team was fantastic! Everything was cleaned up when the job was completed. He explained everything before, during, and after the job. I would recommend him to ANYONE.
reviews.author: Rena Kunkel

reviews.text: I was looking for roof work, and the young lady Stacey was a great help on information. Even though I did not get service today. When we are ready, we are definitely coming back! Thanks Stacey,
reviews.author: Sherlon Salon

reviews.text: I'm very grateful to have had Roof Experts installed my roof. I am totally satisfied with the work . Aimal was so helpful and kept me updated throughout the process. He gave me a great idea of the color of my roof, and I love it!  several of my neighbors have commented on how nice it looks. Thank you, Thank you 😊
reviews.author: Bea Medrano

reviews.text: Great company! There was great communication from the beginning with Mr. Aimal. He made sure to answer all of the questions and communicated with the insurance company timely. He also advocated for the items that needed to be replaced. I would definitely recommend the company and working with him.
reviews.author: Mariela Castro

reviews.text:
Three roofers came to my door. I chose Roof Experts because Aimal was kind, caring, a good listener, and exceptionally thorough from start to finish. He spoke to the insurance company and was present for the inspection with the adjuster. Aimal went above and beyond to ensure that my roof was perfect. Aimal used the best quality  material.

When his team arrived, they were kind, fast, very efficient, and hardworking.  They placed close attention to every detail.

It was a pleasure to do business with Roof Experts. Aimal is very positive and shows a great work ethic.  Thank you Aimal,it was a  pleasure working with you.
reviews.author: Andy Brown

reviews.text: We had a great experience with Roof Experts! They were steadfast in their follow up and helped us get our roof approved through insurance and they then completed the job including cleanup with no issues. Communication was also great. Highly recommend!
reviews.author: Laurie Markovich

reviews.text: Root Experts are awesome with a great crew. They are very professional and Aimal Ata was our Roofing Specialist and he keep updated every step of the way. He even went above and beyond helping with our car the was hail damage d keeping updated on their progress.
reviews.author: Douglas Williams

reviews.text: They did a very professional job, were on time, cleaned up properly and Aimal was great about keeping me up to speed on insurance payments and requirements, warranties,  and timelines.  Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Lynda Roten

reviews.text: Roof Experts did a great job replacing the entire roof on our home. Started and finished in 1 day, while leaving no mess behind. They took care to cover our swimming pool, keeping debris out. I'd recommend them to others looking for a high quality roof.
reviews.author: Ryan Salter

reviews.text: My parents home needed a new roof and the insurance company was awful to work with. Thank goodness we found Roof Experts in Garland, as they handled everything and forced the insurance company to pay more than they quoted.  Great, honest company!! Everything done in 1 day!! Highly recommended...
reviews.author: Robert Lee

reviews.text: They were great.  They spoke to my insurance on my behalf and kept me updated at all times.  Aimal was my go to guy and he was exceptional.  Jeremy was great as well.  Excellent service with quality work and quality materials.  I liked them so much I had them do my father's roof as well.  Highly recommend Roof Experts.
reviews.author: Gregory Alexander

reviews.text: Aimal and his crew did a great job. They showed up when they said they would and Completed  the jod on time. The roof looks great and they left the place clean with no evidence they gad been here.
reviews.author: Tammie Lain

reviews.text: I had the best experience working with Roof Experts after a hailstorm did significant damage to my roof. They were quick and thorough in assessing the damage, and helped me navigate the process with my insurance company, which was overwhelming at times. Overall great quality work and exceptional service.
reviews.author: Brit W

reviews.text: Couldn't ask for a better experience. After being robbed by another roofing company, Roof Experts came in and replaced my roof in a single day. Showed up early, covered the doors and windows before they started and cleaned the area as they went. Very little to pick up after they left. They also coordinated reinstalling my solar panels that had been removed by the other construction company.  They were also very quick and efficient. Could ask for a better experience.
reviews.author: Ben Richerson

reviews.text: Roof experts are INCREDIBLE!! They made the entire process of replacing my roof a breeze. Jessica Cotten walked us through literally every process and made the paperwork simple. If I ever need major house repairs again, these are the people I want!! Roof experts came in exactly the time we needed them most!! The entire work crew seem almost like family.
reviews.author: Alexia Seat

data.summary: Reviews show strong signs of manipulation. Google reviews appear artificially positive with repetitive employee mentions and corporate language, while Yelp shows 1.0 rating suggesting serious customer dissatisfaction. The company has been in business 8 years but has only 18 Google reviews, which is suspiciously low. The single negative review about unpaid referral bonus adds credibility concerns.
fake_signals: Multiple reviews mention same employee names (Aimal, Pasha David) with excessive praise
Google reviews show suspiciously consistent 5-star pattern with similar phrasing
Low review volume (18 Google reviews) for 8-year company
Yelp shows 1.0 rating suggesting serious issues

positive_evidence: Mention of warranties in positive review

authentic_signals: Some specific project details in reviews
One review mentions referral bonus issue with specific month (August)
